# Current Work

- Group Lead for Research Software Engineering at the [German Informatics Society (GI)](https://gi.de/), holding the scientific direction of the [FG RSE](https://fg-rse.gi.de/)
- Directing the [Master Curriculum Research Software Engineering](https://github.com/the-teachingRSE-project/RSE-Masters) (RSE-Master 2025), and representing that work in the [Skills and Training for Research Software (STaRS) Forum](https://www.researchsoft.org/forums/stars-forum/) of the Research Software Alliance
- Project lead of the GI **RSE Award** for outstanding research software, and PI for the GI in **FutuRSI** (Future of Sustainable Research Software Infrastructure)
- Writing a habilitation on methodological research integrity for research software (the **RIGHT** framework); first chapter available as a [preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15366)
- Teaching RSE as a guest lecturer at RWTH Aachen, with two further RSE courses at the University of Potsdam in the coming semester
- Paper projects with the teaching RSE group of [deRSE](https://de-rse.org/de/working_groups.html)
